title: I Will Always Love You
headline: Dolly Parton cried all night after saying no to Elvis
caption:
Saying no to Elvis paid off for Dolly Parton in the end.

Follow for the story behind your next favorite song.

Colonel Tom Parker, Elvis's manager, wanted half the publishing on 'I Will Always Love You.' She refused. Nearly two decades later, Whitney Houston's version sold over 24 million copies worldwide. Dolly even said she liked Whitney's cover better than her own.

Was it the right call, or would you have taken the Elvis cut?

🎧 The song: "I Will Always Love You" by Dolly Parton (@dollyparton)
